about: Flyers for team dates, archived from the JL 3/6, JL Phase B+ and NYC Elite WhatsApp groups, and the JL monthly team calendars (PDF). team-event.html lists the flyers under Flyers in the event list, and a calendar row whose text contains one of a flyer's match words links to that flyer. date sorts the list (blank = no fixed date, listed last). A calendar shows as a link under the Calendar section of every event in its month (and of the month before).

flyers.title: Go 6x15 · Leadership 1 workshop
flyers.alt: Leadership 1 Go 6x15, Bigger Vision Higher Impact. Workshop Oct 24, 2026, 2 to 6 PM EST. To qualify: Phase B IBO, 600 PV GPV in Sept or Oct, or 300 PV GPV in the first October.
flyers.from: JL Phase B+ Info Group, Jerry, 2026-10-06

flyers.title: Glow From Within, Halloween · HY Product Expo
flyers.alt: Glow From Within, Halloween edition. Feel good, look good, live well. Health and nutrition: personalized nutrition. Skincare: blue light skin analysis. Friday, Oct 30, 5:00 to 7:30 PM, 134 W 29th St, Floor 2, Space 1-1, New York, NY 10001. QR code to RSVP.

flyers.title: Year End Trip 2026 · Scottsdale, AZ
flyers.alt: Year End Trip 2026, Scottsdale, Arizona. Five-star hotel downtown, Dec 28 to Jan 1, 4 nights. First 60 people $550 single, $1,500 per couple; the rate goes up after that. Pay Jerry by Zelle or Venmo to hold a spot. Arrive Dec 28 around 6 PM, leave Jan 1.

flyers.title: BBI Trip to Puerto Rico
flyers.alt: The Leadership 1 BBI Trip to Puerto Rico. New BBI in 2026-27: 1 month qualification, 2 months (1 night room paid), 3 months (2 nights room paid). Old BBI qualifiers: one leg qualifies for the BBI trip and one more leg BFI, a new 7500 PV month in 2026-27, or qualified Platinums in 2026-27.
flyers.from: JL Phase B+ Info Group, Jerry, 2026-08-31

flyers.title: 人生修炼局 · online sharing
flyers.alt: 人生修炼局: 找准自己，把钱和人生想明白. Sunday Oct 25, 8:00 to 9:00 PM Beijing time on 腾讯会议. Speakers Johnny & Irene (金融大厂AI转型副总裁, Fintech独角兽运营总监, 12年跨国创业者) and Jerry & Leann (华尔街投行总监, 前华尔街高级数据分析师, 14年跨国创业者). QR code to sign up.
